question: Eight persons L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S were sitting around a square table facing the centre. Some of them were sitting at its corners while some were sitting exactly in the middle of the sides. P was sitting fourth to the left of Q. Only O was sitting between M and Q. N was sitting immediate right of L. R was sitting immediate left of M. L and P were sitting at the corners. Who was sitting fourth to the left of R?
